blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Transnational crimes, migrant workers, as well as oil and food security, will be some of the key points of discussions in the 49th Association of Southeast Asian Nations (Asean) Summit and Related Summits. This information comes from the Asean Summit spokesperson Dominic Xavier Imperial on Friday. Leaders will also discuss transboundary haze from Indonesia and the Five-Point Consensus to address political and humanitarian crisis in Myanmar. “So we should expect some additional measures and decisions from our leaders in addressing the energy situation that we’re facing at the moment, and that’s one,” Imperial said at a press briefing.
